craft_notes: Sthāyin: pleading protection (stotra's hinge). Device: comma→dash (plumbing held), em-dash→comma (snipping softens onto keeping). Rejected: 'her' disambiguated (māyā named) — killed: tāṃ kept as her, antecedent open per argmap. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: What longings plumb her farthest marge — who snicks
glamour in one wink, keep us, Śiva, her.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yasyāḥ prāpyeta paryantaviśeṣaḥ kair manorathaiḥ māyām ekanimeṣeṇa muṣṇaṃs tāṃ pātu naḥ śivaḥ

reads_against.argmap: By which wishes could her end-distinction be reached.; Stealing māyā in one wink — may that Śiva protect us. → May Śiva who steals māyā in a wink protect us.
reads_against.l2: What longings could sound her farthest shore — her who filches glamour in a single blink? Śiva, keep us.
